description: This plot illustrates the "Hidden State Mean" across different layers for three distinct conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 24, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to over 4, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines, none of which utilize markers. The blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". It begins near 0 at Layer 0, exhibits a gradual, slightly stepped increase to approximately 1.0 at Layer 10 and 2.0 at Layer 17, before experiencing a sharp vertical spike that exceeds the visible y-axis limit of 4 between Layers 19 and 20. The orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". It starts near 0 at Layer 0 and follows a steady, linear upward trend, ending at approximately 1.0 near Layer 24. The green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". It closely overlaps the orange dotted line throughout the entire plot, starting near 0 at Layer 0 and increasing steadily in a linear fashion to end at approximately 1.0 near Layer 24.
